mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the floor was the clearest construction change: the disc visibly covered the opening and explained what the tabs would secure.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two tab-folding results were difficult to distinguish from their preceding states in the text descriptions.

surprise.text: The base had to be flipped before joining it to the drum, leaving the assembly upside down until the final flip; the reason for that order was not clear to me.

arbitrary.text: Flipping the base before attachment felt somewhat arbitrary because its purpose was not explained.

continue.text: I would continue to see the fish band and animation completed, although the repeated folds and flips were less engaging than the visible assembly changes.
